excerpt.zh: 人群中的叛乱分子正伺机推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
excerpt.en: Rebellious elements of the populace are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

texts.zh: 人群中的叛乱分子正伺机推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
texts.en: Rebellious elements of the populace are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

texts.zh: 揭竿而起的奴隶正在谋求推翻我们在[Target.GetName]的统治！
texts.en: Upstart slaves are seeking to overthrow our rule on [Target.GetName]!

texts.zh: 不安分的个体有机体正试图将自己从我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]脱离。
texts.en: Restless, singleton organisms seek to remove themselves from our [Owner.GetGovernmentName].

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的无序反常个体正试图让整个星球脱离我们的掌控。
texts.en: Unaligned and deviant elements on [Target.GetName] seek to wrest the world from our grasp.

texts.zh: 一组顽固的共生体寻求从我们的[owner.GetGovernmentName]中脱离。
texts.en: A fractious cell of symbionts seeks freedom from our [owner.GetGovernmentName].

sections.zh: [Target.System.GetName]星系有实力强劲的恒星基地

texts.zh: 自[Root.GetName]传来的最新报告表明，一些唯心主义领袖正在四处煽风点火，当地发酵的动荡局面都有他们的领导。这些人承诺将会把民众从当前面临的种种困境中解救出来，因此吸引了不少名望，结果就是抵抗运动表现出了明显的唯心主义特征。
texts.en: Our latest reports from [Root.GetName] suggest that spiritual leaders are taking a lead role in fomenting the unrest that has been brewing there. Promising deliverance from the hardship they are currently facing, they have managed to successfully appeal to the populace, with the result that the resistance has taken on a distinctly spiritualist character.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的骚乱使得殖民地政治舞台的前沿有了新的风貌；民粹主义铁腕人士登场，不惜以自由为代价换取社会的秩序。他们在当前不断升级的行星骚乱中均处于显要的位置。
texts.en: The disturbances on [Root.GetName] have propelled a new narrative to the forefront of the colony's political stage; one of populist strongmen and order at the expense of freedom. They are taking a prominent role in the unrest that continues to escalate on the planet.

texts.zh: 随着[Root.GetName]的社会秩序不断崩塌，抵抗势力对外来者抱有的敌意与日俱增，他们将这些同当地人不一样的人视作巨大的憎恶。一些领袖更是贴出了排外主义的标语，结果导致物种之间的关系变得更加紧张了。
texts.en: As the social order continues to break down on [Root.GetName], residents have become markedly more hostile to outsiders, viewing those unlike themselves with considerable antipathy. Their leaders are deploying ever more xenophobic slogans, with the result that interspecies relations have become increasingly tense.

texts.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]当地的一些唯心主义领袖们根本无法控制殖民地上动乱的蔓延，人们开始对自己所居住的物质领域有更为理性的认识。不幸的是，尽管他们专注逻辑，却没有得出那个无可辩驳的结论——他们的美好生活是由[Root.Owner.GetName]境内的其他人提供的——暂时是这样。
texts.en: The inability of some local spiritual leaders on [Root.GetName] to even begin to calm the rampant unrest on the colony has lead to the populace taking a more rational view of the material realm they inhabit. Unfortunately, their focus on logic has not led them to the irrefutable conclusion that they are best served by remaining within the [Root.Owner.GetName]... yet.

texts.zh: 据报告，[Root.GetName]上愈演愈烈的叛乱，至少有部分原因是因为对外星物种的不公平对待。他们的领袖已经起草了一份表单，列出了所有的不公正和歧视行为，并勒令对其改正。如果没能满足要求，他们会毫不犹豫地推翻殖民地的当地政府。
texts.en: The mounting unrest on [Root.GetName] is reportedly caused, at least in part, by our perceived hostility towards aliens. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and acts of discrimination that they demand be corrected. Failing this, they will not balk at pushing for a change of administration on the colony.

texts.zh: 即使[Root.GetName]出现了不断扩大的社会隔阂，当地社区仍然因一些剧变更加紧密，在人人平等的理念下团结一致。他们的领袖已经起草了一份表单，列出了所有的不公正和歧视行为，并勒令对其改正。如果没能满足要求，他们保证殖民地的政治局势会进一步恶化。
texts.en: Even as widening social rifts manifest on [Root.GetName], local communities are galvanized by the upheaval and united by a common desire for greater equality. Their leaders have drawn up a charter listing supposed injustices and inequalities they demand be corrected. Failing this, they promise that the political situation on the colony will only deteriorate.

texts.zh: 威胁进行武力干预对解除[Root.GetName]上的零星骚乱毫无成效。事实上，当地人看上去对这种控制手段已经失去了信心，现在更加卖力地动员进行非暴力抵抗运动。
texts.en: The threat of forceful intervention has done little to dissuade the disruptive elements on [Root.GetName]. In fact, the locals seem to have lost faith in this method of control, and are now increasingly mobilizing for nonviolent resistance.

texts.zh: 我们没能遏止住[Root.GetName]上持续不断的动乱，当地民众愈发要求军方更加直接地干涉，在他们的母星以及整个[Root.Owner.GetName]境内维持治安。当地老兵累积了许多名望，在日渐活跃的抵抗运动中占据了重要的位置。
texts.en: Our failure to contain the unrest on [Root.GetName] has led to mounting calls from the locals for a more pronounced military presence, both on their home planet and within the [Root.Owner.GetName] as a whole. Local military veterans are enjoying a rise in popularity, and have assumed prominent roles within the growing resistance movement.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了组织更加严密的抵抗，由一位捉摸不透的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]干部进行领导。幸运的是，看上去他们的宣传还未在更大范围引起波澜，当下叛乱仅仅局限在那个殖民地。
texts.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] dissidents. Fortunately, it seems their propaganda has not struck a cord elsewhere, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了组织更加严密的抵抗，由一位捉摸不透的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]干部进行领导。更糟糕的是：看上去他们的宣传已经在更大范围引起波澜，他们的斗争已经激励了[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他临近殖民地上的不满分子跟从发难。如果我们不能控制住这里的局势，我们可能马上就要面临一场大范围的叛乱了。
texts.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] dissidents. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired dissidents on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了更加严密的抵抗组织，由一位不知底细的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]逃亡者进行领导。幸运的是，看上去他们的行径尚未催化任何形式的模仿行为，目前其他殖民地的奴隶没有掀起波澜。
texts.en: Rebellious slaves on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] escapees. Fortunately, it seems their example has not inspired any imitators, and at present slave populations on other colonies remain suitably downtrodden.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上零星的叛乱分子现在形成了更加严密的抵抗组织，由一位摸不清底细的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]逃亡者进行领导。更糟糕的是：看上去他们的宣传已经在更大范围引起波澜，他们的斗争已经激励了[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他临近殖民地上的不满分子跟从发难。如果我们不能控制住这里的局势，我们可能马上就要面临一场大范围的叛乱了。
texts.en: Rebellious slaves on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance, led by an elusive cadre of [rebellion_species.GetAdj] escapees. Even worse: their dastardly propaganda seems to have struck a cord, and their struggles have inspired slaves on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies to launch copycat movements. If we cannot take control of the situation, we may soon have a widespread revolt on our hands.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子现在变得越来越擅长于抗拒我们的指令。令人警觉的是，这个星球上的子个体相互之间开始发生独立于主体意识的对话。如果这样的事情继续发生，他们很可能形成一个分离的意识，从我们中脱离。幸运的是，看上去我们成功地将这种反常遏止在了这个殖民地，就算他们成功，也不会有其他的行星实体加入。
texts.en: Divergent elements on [Target.GetName] are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. Alarmingly, the drones on the world have started to have conversations separate from the primary mind. If this keeps happening they might form a splinter consciousness, separate from us. Fortunately, it seems we have managed to contain this deviancy to the colony, and no other planetary entities are set to join them, should they succeed.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子现在变得越来越擅长于抗拒我们的指令。似乎他们很快就能实现自己的目的，建立一个脱离我们控制的[rebellion_species.GetAdj]实体。更糟糕的是：如果他们成功的话，[join_revolt_planet.GetName]和其他临近的殖民地看上去也打算加入。如果我们不能重新取得这个局势的控制权，我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]可能很快就要遭受巨大的分裂。
texts.en: Divergent elements on [Target.GetName] are becoming ever more effective in resisting our commands. It seems they may soon realize their aims to establish a [rebellion_species.GetAdj] entity outside of our control. Even worse: [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，被标记为[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]的叛乱个体生命现在组成了一个更加有组织性的抵抗运动，进而反对我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。幸运的是，好像他们的不满情绪并未扩散开来，当前骚乱仅仅局限在这个殖民地。
texts.en: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Fortunately, it seems their dissent has not spread further, and at present the unrest is localized on that colony.

texts.zh: 在[Target.GetName]，被标记为[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]的叛乱个体生命现在组成了一个更加有组织性的抵抗运动，进而反对我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]。更糟糕的是：一旦他们成功，[join_revolt_planet.GetName]以及其他附近[rebellion_species.GetAdj]聚居的殖民地也打算加入。如果我们不能重新获得局势的控制权，我们的[Owner.GetGovernmentName]势必将遭受严重的分裂。
texts.en: Rebellious individualistic life forms designated as [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] on [Target.GetName] now form an increasingly organized resistance in their opposition to our [Owner.GetGovernmentName]. Even worse: [join_revolt_planet.GetName] and other nearby [rebellion_species.GetAdj]-populated colonies appear set to join them, should they succeed. If we are unable to regain control of the situation, our [Owner.GetGovernmentName] may soon suffer a significant rupture.

texts.zh:
我们开始与一撮[target.GetName]上的不安分共生体失去联络。我们有时候已经感觉不到它们的存在了。我们担心如果这种情况继续下去，这颗行星可能会分裂出一个新的意识，从我们的大集体中分离出去。

这种反常现象还未散布到我们其他宇宙空间的行星自我上。在[target.GetName]的共生体如果脱离了我们，我们……他们就会独自行动了。
texts.en:
We are beginning to lose touch with an increasingly unruly clutch of symbionts on [target.GetName]. Already, there are moments when we can no longer feel their presence at all. We fear that if this continues, the world itself may form a splintered consciousness, separate from our wider self.

This deviancy has not yet spread to our planet-selves in other regions of space. Should our symbionts on [target.GetName] succeed in breaking away, we... they... would do so alone.

texts.zh: 我们与越来越多不安分的共生体失去了联系，不只是[target.GetName]，很不幸地是连[join_revolt_planet.GetName]也是如此了。我们有时候已经完全感觉不到他们的存在：整个世界变得遥远又陌生……我们担心这种情况继续下去，那些跑偏的共生体可能会分裂出自己的独立意识。这将给我们留下无数可怕的后果。
texts.en: We are losing touch with an increasing number of unruly symbionts, not only on [target.GetName] but tragically on [join_revolt_planet.GetName] as well. Already, there are moments when we can no longer feel their presence at all: whole worlds becoming more distant, alienated from us... We fear that if this continues, our wayward symbionts might form a splintered consciousness of their own. This would have dire consequences for whatever remains of us afterwards.

texts.zh: 一个在我们[owner.GetGovernmentName]掌控之外的[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]反叛核心已经成型，其目标是强制让[target.GetName]独立。无论谋杀是否是蓄意为之，这种行为都会致命地切断我们与该星球上的共生体的联系。幸运的是他们的反叛目前还局限于[target.GetName]，处于掌控之中。
texts.en: A rebellious core of [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] who already dwell outside our [owner.GetGovernmentName] have organized, with the goal of forcing independence upon [target.GetName]. Whether or not murder is their intended goal, such an act act would fatally sever our link with the symbionts on that world. Fortunately their rebellion remains limited to [target.GetName] for now, and so might yet be contained.

texts.zh: 一个在我们[owner.GetGovernmentName]掌控之外的[rebellion_species.GetNamePlural]反叛核心已经成型，宣称其目标不止是强行让[target.GetName]独立，更包括了其他如[join_revolt_planet.GetName]等他们的同伴所居住的星球上。他们想要与我们分离的欲望就像感染一样令人瘙痒，扰乱当地的共生体。如果与我们的集体意识分离，这些共生体就会灭亡。
texts.en: A rebellious core of [rebellion_species.GetNamePlural] who already dwell outside our [owner.GetGovernmentName] have organized, with the stated goal of independence not only on [target.GetName], but wherever else their kind dwell on worlds like [join_revolt_planet.GetName]. Their desire to break from us itches like an infection, upsetting local symbionts who would perish if severed from our mutualistic consciousness.

label.zh: 我们应该将其扼杀在萌芽阶段。
label.en: We shall nip this in the bud.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人群已经揭竿而起。他们摈弃了我们的统治，现在称他们自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这种动荡不会进一步扩散……
texts.en: The populace on [Target.GetName] are rebelling! They have cast off our rule and now style themselves the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this instability does not spread further...

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]已经被复仇主义分子夺走了！他们摈弃了我们的统治，现在同[new_owner_empire.GetName]统一了。
texts.en: [Target.GetName] has been seized by revanchist elements! They have cast off our rule and united with the [new_owner_empire.GetName].

texts.zh: 未敢设想的事情发生了。[Root.Target.GetName]上的奴隶人口联合起来，对我们当地的统治公然发起武装叛乱。局势迅速恶化，叛乱分子同时袭击破坏了许多关键的目标。我们部队溃不成军，最后一名效忠者被奴隶叛军无情地绞死。他们已经宣布了独立，这是[Root.GetSpeciesName]历史上灰暗的一天。
texts.en: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have now declared independence. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.

texts.zh: 未敢设想的事情发生了。[Root.Target.GetName]上的奴隶人口联合起来，对我们当地的统治公然发起武装叛乱。局势迅速恶化，叛乱分子同时袭击破坏了许多关键的目标。我们部队溃不成军，最后一名效忠者被奴隶叛军无情地绞死。他们已经投入了[new_owner_empire.GetName]的怀抱中，这是[Root.GetSpeciesName]历史上灰暗的一天。
texts.en: The unthinkable has happened. The slave population on [Root.Target.GetName] has united and risen in open, armed revolt against the local leadership. The situation escalated quickly, as rebel forces struck against and disabled several key targets simultaneously. Our forces have been routed and our last loyal subjects executed mercilessly by the slave rebels, who have thrown themselves at the mercy of the [new_owner_empire.GetName]. It is a dark day in the history of [Root.GetSpeciesName]kind.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的反常分子从我们手中夺走了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们隔离了自己的思想，并形成了一个新的、独立的蜂巢思维，现在称呼自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这股反常不会在我们的突触中进一步扩散……
texts.en: Deviant elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated their thoughts and formed a new, independent Hive Mind, which is now calling itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our synapses...

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的不配合分子从我们手中夺走了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们放逐了我们的突触和子个体，宣称自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能眼睁睁地看着这场独立思想酿成的危险展示。
texts.en: Unaligned elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our synapses and drones, and declared themselves the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的不配合分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经将我们的思想隔绝开，并谋求同[new_owner_empire.GetName]合并。
texts.en: Unaligned elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have isolated themselves from our thoughts and sought union with the [new_owner_empire.GetName].

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]的叛乱要素已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，取而代之设立了一个新的人工智能，称呼自己为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能希望这样的动乱不会进一步在我们的处理器中传播开来……
texts.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing instead a new AI, which calls itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We can only hope this perversion does not spread further through our processors...

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上有机人群的叛乱分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，建立了一个新的政治实体，并称之为[rebel_empire.GetName]。我们只能眼睁睁地看着这场独立思想酿成的危险展示。
texts.en: Rebellious elements of the organic populace on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, establishing a new entity which they call the [rebel_empire.GetName]. One can only wonder at this dangerous display of independent thought.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的叛乱分子已经从我们手中夺取了这个[Target.GetPlanetMoon]！他们已经驱逐了我们的管理子处理器，并将自己从我们的导航信号中隔绝开来，同时谋求同[new_owner_empire.GetName]合并，他们宣称该帝国同他们的兼容性更好。
texts.en: Rebellious elements on [Target.GetName] have seized the [Target.GetPlanetMoon] from us! They have cast out our governance sub-processors and isolated themselves from our guiding signals, seeking union with the [new_owner_empire.GetName], an empire they claim to be more compatible with.

texts.zh: [target.GetName]已成功挣脱了我们的掌控。在这具欲望与目的的完美化身中，那些不安的共生体凭借自身意志选择了独立。它自称为[rebel_empire.GetName]。此番失去，令吾等实力大损。
texts.en: [target.GetName] has succeeded in wrenching itself from us. By the will of its own troubled symbionts, this beautiful embodiment of desire and purpose has struck out on its own. It has called itself the [rebel_empire.GetName]. We are diminished by its loss.

texts.zh: [target.GetName]上的凶残叛军成功驱逐了我们的共生体，将那颗星球的心脏撕出，只留下一具空洞的躯壳。我们只能希望这场无耻的暴行将导致所谓[rebel_empire.GetName]陷入极度困境，他们如今不得不在失去我们丰饶恩赐的境况下艰难求生。
texts.en: Murderous rebels on [target.GetName] have succeeded in casting out our symbionts, tearing the Heart out of that world and leaving a mere shell of its former self. We can only hope this brazen act of violence leads to extreme hardship for the so-called [rebel_empire.GetName], who must now eke out a living without our bounteous gifts.

texts.zh: [target.GetName]已完全挣脱我们的掌控，选择与[new_owner_empire.GetName]融为一体。在其自身不安的共生体意志驱使下，这个曾繁荣壮大的集体分支，如今在另一种截然不同的意识形态中寻求归宿。我们再也听不见它的歌声，此消彼长间，我们因这份缺失而衰微。
texts.en: [target.GetName] has succeeded in wrenching itself from us, choosing instead to merge with the [new_owner_empire.GetName]. By the will of its own troubled symbionts, this once flourishing aspect of our greater self has sought purpose in an altogether different form of consciousness. We no longer hear its songs, and are diminished by its loss.

label.en: This is an act of war.
This is an act of war.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle][Root.GetRulerName]，向您致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，代表[rebel_planet.GetName]的叛乱势力。

我们极度喜悦地报告，我们已经成功推翻了[old_owner.GetAdj]的压迫者，这都要感谢你们的支持。我们衷心希望，你的管理会比我们刚刚摆脱的那种暴政更加有益。
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]. I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], representing the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

We are overjoyed to report that we have managed to overthrow our [old_owner.GetAdj] oppressors, thanks to your support. Hopefully, your governance will prove more propitious than that we have just cast off...

texts.zh:
致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，[rebel_planet.GetName]上叛乱势力的音频子个体。

多亏你的支持，我们已经将自己的意识从压迫成性的[old_owner.GetName]分离出来。我们衷心希望，你的[Root.GetGovernmentName]的引导能够使我们变得更加团结，让我们得到妥善地恢复。
texts.en:
Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

Thanks to your support, we have separated our consciousness from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, the guidance of your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more unifying and allow us proper convalescence.

texts.zh:
致敬！我是[exiled_rebel.GetName]，[rebel_planet.GetName]上叛乱势力的音频子个体。

多亏你的支持，我们已经将自己的系统从压迫成性的[old_owner.GetName]分离出来。我们衷心希望，你的[Root.GetGovernmentName]能够同我们的网络更加兼容。
texts.en:
Greetings! I am [exiled_rebel.GetName], Voice Drone for the rebellion on [rebel_planet.GetName].

Thanks to your support, we have separated our systems from the oppressive [old_owner.GetName]. Hopefully, your [Root.GetGovernmentName] will prove more compatible with our networks.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。随着不满分子逐渐改邪归正，和平得到恢复，我们的当地政府也重新确立了控制。
texts.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as dissidents gradually return to the fold, and our local authorities reassert their control.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。和平得到恢复，我们的主管突触和节点重新将当地的思想模式带回了主巢思想的掌控。
texts.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing synapses and nodes bring local thought patterns back into the fold.

texts.zh: [target.GetName]已恢复平静状态，我们的星球本体不再受疑虑与矛盾冲动的困扰。那里的共生体已重归集体，如同我们过去一样体验生命。我们再次获得了安宁。
texts.en: [target.GetName] has returned to as state of calm, with our world-self no longer harried by doubt and conflicting urges. The symbionts there have returned to the fold, experiencing life as we did before. We are at peace again.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱已经被粉碎。和平得到恢复，我们的主管算法捣毁了不满的当地网络。
texts.en: The rebellion on [Root.GetName] has been quashed. Calm is restored as our governing algorithm quashes dissenting local networks.

texts.zh: 在一次满怀恶意的造反行动中，[Root.GetName]上的奴隶们用自制炸药摧毁了工厂设施。尽管爆炸发生在夜间，他们还是用触发警报的方式将毫无疑心的工厂领导人们引到了现场。这次袭击协调顺畅，执行完美。无论罪犯是谁，他们一定秘密策划了好几个月。
texts.en: In a vicious act of defiance, the slaves on [Root.GetName] have destroyed work facilities with the help of homemade explosives. Though the detonations took place at night, they lured their unsuspecting work leaders to the location by triggering the alarm system. The attack was well coordinated and flawlessly executed. Whoever the guilty are, they must have planned it for months.

label.zh: 这些行为必将受到惩罚。
label.en: These acts will not go unpunished.

label.zh: 我们必须解决我们之间的分歧。

texts.zh: 我们成功镇压了[revolt_planet.GetName]上的叛乱。多亏了勇敢的士兵和殖民地协调者们的通力合作，我们在关键设施处重新站稳了脚跟，并恢复了当局的秩序。那些妄图逃脱的奴隶们被羁押回了本该待的地方。短时间内应该不会有人胆敢反抗我们了。
texts.en: We have put an end to the rebellion on [revolt_planet.GetName]. Thanks to the efforts of our brave troops and colonial coordinators, we have re-established our hold on key facilities, and reinstated our authority. The would-be breakaway slaves are back in line where they belong. It should be some time before anyone dares to defy us again.

label.zh: 现在他们应该会安分守己了。
